scope: 193 sovereign states only; autonomous/special regions separately maintained in territory_official_sources.json
policy: Public official defence institution links only. The three entries must be meaningful, distinguishable official military/defence organizations or service branches, not copies of a single publisher section. Do not assume all sovereign states maintain standing armies. Empty records indicate pending research, not military absence. These links are not verified live military intelligence or alert feeds. No geolocation of troops, installations, operations or weapons.
